title: Commercial Kitchen Equipment Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Commercial Kitchen Equipment Inspection Checklist covers cooking, warewashing, holding, preparation, ventilation, or connected utility equipment. The kitchen facilities coordinator records Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Commercial Kitchen Equipment Inspection Checklist keeps Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service exceptions visible until the kitchen facilities coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Commercial Kitchen Equipment Inspection Checklist at kitchen line, dish area, preparation area, utility point, and equipment position. Document cooking, warewashing, holding, preparation, ventilation, or connected utility equipment identity before Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service begins. Compare cooking, warewashing, holding, preparation, ventilation, or connected utility equipment findings with stated Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service criteria; route unresolved Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service issues to qualified commercial-equipment service supervisor. For Commercial Kitchen Equipment Inspection Checklist, confirm requirements for Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service. Ask qualified commercial-equipment service supervisor to review Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service conditions beyond the kitchen facilities coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service, identify responsible parties, kitchen line, dish area, preparation area, utility point, and equipment position, and the linked cooking, warewashing, holding, preparation, ventilation, or connected utility equipment source.

fields.label: Equipment type, make, model, serial, and asset tag
Reported symptom, menu impact, and service reference

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service facts for cooking, warewashing, holding, preparation, ventilation, or connected utility equipment; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service inspection checks
items: Power, gas, water, steam, drain, and ventilation connection condition
Guards, interlocks, doors, latches, and accessible controls
Heating, cooling, washing, holding, or cycle result
Temperature, pressure, timing, and displayed fault readings
Clearance, anchorage, casters, and restraint condition

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Kitchen Facilities Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Gas odor, damaged conductor, or active leak
Unsafe temperature control or failed safety device
Utility or ventilation defect outside service scope
Equipment label and pre-work condition images
blocks.guidance: Pause Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service when a utility hazard, failed safety control, sanitation concern, or unsafe operating result remains. Retain the available Commercial Kitchen Equipment Service proof and route unresolved cooking, warewashing, holding, preparation, ventilation, or connected utility equipment scope to kitchen facilities coordinator.
